fatigue_thresholds.high: Suggest recovery meal if no extremely close vendors exist.
fatigue_thresholds.low: Encourage walking to a healthy vendor if available.

recovery_meals: Oats, Peanut Butter, and Banana (Quick Carbs & Protein)
Scrambled Eggs with Spinach (High Protein & Iron)
Greek Yogurt with Mixed Berries and Almonds (Probiotics & Antioxidants)
general_tips: Drink a glass of water before deciding what to eat.
Avoid heavy carb meals if you have more work to do.
A 10-minute walk can help reset your appetite.
